t: What Aquaculture Performance Database Is All About
title: What Aquaculture Performance Database Is All About
description: Aquaculture is the fastest-growing food sector: salmon (Norway, Chile), shrimp (Southeast Asia), tilapia, and oysters (the restorative crop — filtering water as they grow). Performance is feed conversion (salmon ~1.2:1), survival, and growth rate; risks are disease (sea lice, EMS shrimp virus), escapes, and waste. Closed containment and IMTA (multi-trophic: fish + shellfish + seaweed) are the sustainable frontiers. This database is the complete aquaculture record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Aquaculture Performance Database: a complete reference database of full aquaculture record records.
key_points: What this database holds: full aquaculture record records, each with definition, key facts, and a runnable demo program.
